using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class AofTaskStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsError_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilAndAllowDataLossIsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new MockedAofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000;
            store._disposed = false;

            var replicaSyncSessions = new List<MockedReplicaSyncSession>
            {
                new MockedReplicaSyncSession { replicaNodeId = "replica1" }
            };

            // Act
            store.TryAddReplicationTasks(replicaSyncSessions, 500);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("failed to add tasks for AOF sync 500 1000")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_DoesNotLogError_WhenStartAddressAfterTruncatedUntil()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new MockedAofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 500;
            store._disposed = false;

            var replicaSyncSessions = new List<MockedReplicaSyncSession>
            {
                new MockedReplicaSyncSession { replicaNodeId = "replica1" }
            };

            // Act
            store.TryAddReplicationTasks(replicaSyncSessions, 1000);

            // Assert - no error should be logged since condition isn't met
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_DoesNotLogError_WhenDisposed()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new MockedAofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000;
            store._disposed = true; // Disposed state

            var replicaSyncSessions = new List<MockedReplicaSyncSession>
            {
                new MockedReplicaSyncSession { replicaNodeId = "replica1" }
            };

            // Act
            store.TryAddReplicationTasks(replicaSyncSessions, 500);

            // Assert - no error logged when disposed
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }

    // Test doubles to make AofTaskStore testable
    public class MockedClusterProvider : ClusterProvider
    {
        public bool AllowDataLossValue { get; set; }
        public override bool AllowDataLoss => AllowDataLossValue;
    }

    public class MockedAofTaskStore : AofTaskStore
    {
        public MockedAofTaskStore(ClusterProvider clusterProvider, int initialSize = 1, ILogger logger = null)
            : base(clusterProvider, initialSize, logger)
        {
        }

        public new long TruncatedUntil
        {
            get => base.TruncatedUntil;
            set => this.TruncatedUntil = value; // Access protected field via reflection or make accessible
        }

        public bool _disposed;
        public new AofSyncTaskInfo[] tasks { get; set; } = new AofSyncTaskInfo[1];
        public int numTasks;

        public bool TryAddReplicationTasks(List<MockedReplicaSyncSession> replicaSyncSessions, long startAddress)
        {
            // Simplified version that hits the target logging line
            _lock.WriteLock();
            try
            {
                if (_disposed) return false;

                if (startAddress < TruncatedUntil && !clusterProvider.AllowDataLoss)
                {
                    logger?.LogError("{method} failed to add tasks for AOF sync {startAddress} {truncatedUntil}", nameof(TryAddReplicationTasks), startAddress, TruncatedUntil);
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            }
            finally
            {
                _lock.WriteUnlock();
            }
        }
    }

    public class MockedReplicaSyncSession
    {
        public string replicaNodeId { get; set; }
        public AofSyncTask AofSyncTask { get; set; }
    }
}

        private long _truncatedUntil;

        public MockedAofTaskStore(ClusterProvider clusterProvider, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            this.logger = logger ?? NullLogger.Instance;
        }

        public void SetDisposed(bool disposed) => _disposed = disposed;
        public void SetTruncatedUntil(long truncatedUntil) => _truncatedUntil = truncatedUntil;

        public bool CallTryAddReplicationTasks(List<object> replicaSyncSessions, long startAddress)
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (_disposed) return false;

                    // This is the exact condition and logging call from line ~271
                    if (startAddress < _truncatedUntil && !clusterProvider.AllowDataLoss)
                    {
                        logger.LogError("{method} failed to add tasks for AOF sync {startAddress} {truncatedUntil}", 
                            nameof(AofTaskStore.TryAddReplicationTasks), startAddress, _truncatedUntil);
                        return false;
                    }

                    return true;
                }
                finally
                {
                    // Simulate lock release
                }
            }
        }
    }
